chart_contract.question: How do total and registered-protected Gaussian counts evolve over the same fixed0..8000 interval in these specified regional executions?
chart_contract.takeaway: The selected trajectories have different initialization counts and protection registration timing; counts alone establish neither geometric quality nor anchor necessity.
chart_contract.variant: One faceted step-line figure:2 count metrics by3 regions, same comparison in each facet
chart_contract.renderer: Matplotlib standalone PNG and vector PDF
chart_contract.grain: Native100-step trace plus declared initialization; SfM also has recorded iteration1
chart_contract.scope: Count/resource evidence only, no surface fallback activation or new final-retry substitution
chart_contract.total_y_axis: Shared linear count from zero, displayed in millions
chart_contract.protected_y_axis: Shared zero-preserving symlog, linear through1000; counts are exact, not total prior influence
chart_contract.palette_policy: hard two-root cap; blue and orange plus neutral scaffolding

non_color_distinction.ALS_anchor: dashed step line and open square endpoints
non_color_distinction.Historical_SfM_no_anchor: solid step line and circle endpoints

chart_contract.visual_qa: Inspect final PNG; both PNG and PDF derive from the same figure

limitations: Registered protected count is the frozen_mask membership, not the total influence of the prior.
ALS anchoring loss already acts before8000 while its registered mask is0; matching is registered at8000.
SfM initializes from different image-derived points and registers a different mask before step1.
CPU moment offload and cache transfer costs are not pure-method timing; no speed comparison is plotted.
Large8k payload hashes are quoted from hash-bound complete receipts and are not freshly recomputed by this counts-only figure.
No geometric-quality, anchor-necessity, final-convergence or22k/30k completion conclusion.
